segments.en: Whoever truly wishes to think about his eternal purpose — that he not be lost in his sins, etc. — as he knows within himself what has happened with him. And there is no stratagem or counsel to go out — except through being willing to draw close to the truly wise one who knows deep counsels to take him out.
But he does not know where he is — because of the great abundance of the fire of the great dispute against the Tzadik.
